items.name: Wanderlust
items.desc: Everywhere in the galaxy, there are wonders to behold and lessons to be learned.

items.name: Archaeo-Engineers
items.desc: Combining proven archaic technology with contemporary engineering will give us a timeless advantage.

items.name: Lord of War
items.desc: Some say war is bad for business, but war is our business. Our mercenaries thrive in an embattled galaxy, and through them, so will we.

items.name: Hydrocentric
items.desc: No longer shall we settle for "good enough" replacements for our oceanic abodes: no planet shall be deemed fit for colonization until it has been thoroughly inundated.
items.possible:
has_technology = tech_terrestrial_sculpting
has_aquatic_trait = yes

items.name: Enigmatic Engineering
items.desc: Technology is simply not a way to solve a problem, but it is a language by which we ascend beyond the mundane. Lesser minds simply fail to understand our advances.

items.name: Nihilistic Acquisition
items.desc: The notion of self-determination cannot be a moral absolute. Holistic goals clearly outweigh individual concerns.

items.name: Colossus Project
items.desc: The Colossus Project is where fevered dreams of terror and deterrence meet. A vision of the biggest ship, carrying a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.

items.name: World Shaper
items.desc: To carefully shape and alter the ecosystem of an entire planet into something else is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay.

items.name: Galactic Force Projection
items.desc: The fleet is the instrument by which the will of our empire is made manifest - we live or die depending on its strength.

items.name: Interstellar Dominion
items.desc: The stars beckon and we follow. May nothing stand between us and them.

items.name: Grasp the Void
items.desc: The vast expanse of the galaxy holds limitless riches for those empires that understand how to maintain their grasp on the void.

items.name: Eternal Vigilance
items.desc: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of invading our space must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.

items.name: Eternal Vigilance
items.desc: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of facing our arkships must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.

items.name: Galactic Contender
items.desc: The Fallen Empires cling to the ruins of their decrepit civilizations, ever fearful of the younger and more dynamic races that surround them. Their time has long since passed.

items.name: Technological Ascendancy
items.desc: Technologies that would have been indistinguishable from magic mere generations ago are now within our reach. A new age of technology has begun.

items.name: One Vision
items.desc: True unity is achieved only when the ultimate goals of a nation and its people are one and the same. After all, a house divided against itself cannot stand.

items.name: Consecrated Worlds
items.desc: The galaxy is home to many holy places, some more obvious than others. As mortals, we still struggle to divine the true nature of the universe.

items.name: Mastery of Nature
items.desc: Although we mastered the nature of our homeworld long ago, the alien biomes we have since encountered present new challenges. They too shall be overcome.

items.name: Imperial Prerogative
items.desc: As our civilization continues to grow, so its beating heart must also expand. More systems will be placed under our direct control.

items.name: Executive Vigor
items.desc: There will be no half-measures or compromises when implementing the edicts decided upon by our government. We go all the way, or not at all.

items.name: Transcendent Learning
items.desc: Our society must change its approach towards learning, and by doing so, our best and brightest will be able to reach a completely new level of achievements.

items.name: Shared Destiny
items.desc: As we reach for ever greater heights, we must not leave behind those who have loyally served us. The glorious future of our empire was always meant to be a shared destiny.

items.name: Voidborne
items.desc: We have adapted to permanent habitation in the depths of space, reducing our infrastructure needs and yielding more room for other functions.
items.potential:
is_void_dweller_empire = no

items.name: Master Builders
items.desc: Building a Megastructure requires an unprecedented amount of resources and planning. We are breaking new ground in the field of macro-engineering.

items.name: Galactic Wonders
items.desc: Megastructures are rightfully regarded as the wonders of our time. The scope of such a project would have been unimaginable mere generations ago.

items.name: Machine Worlds
items.desc: We shall shape our worlds into a mirror image of ourselves, replacing the frailty of biology with the immutable perfection of metal.

items.name: Hive Worlds

items.name: Arcology Project
items.desc: Thus shall we make a world of the city, and a city of the world.

items.name: Xeno-Compatibility
items.desc: The invention of universal sexual biology has revolutionized society. Even if it sometimes requires awkward rotations to make a connection.

items.name: Universal Transactions
items.desc: We shall extend our brand and our business to every solar system in the galaxy. Prosperity is eternal!

items.name: Detox
items.desc: Our newest advancements in terraforming allow us to breathe new life into a class of planets formerly considered irrevocably deadly and beyond salvation.

items.name: Mechromancy
items.desc: Biologicals are merely a different kind of machine. We can stimulate the appropriate synapses and reanimate these creatures, for our own benefit.

items.name: Galactic Weather Control
items.desc: Our latest advances in astrometeorology grant us the ability to manifest Cosmic Storms on command. With the right technology, we can even choose the type of storm to create.
